confirmed.statement: The participant section reports 2,500 entrants, 23 who did not enter the matching queue, 167 who quit or timed out before matching, and 2,310 task completers, matching the form.

The exclusion applies to 83 human-human sessions (reported as 14% of human-human teams) in which a partner did not complete; sessions are excluded from all analyses because submission required both participants to confirm. The form correctly describes sessions rather than asserting that 83 is an excluded-person count.

The paper does not reconcile 2,310 completers, 83 excluded sessions, and 2,234 analyzed people; completers minus analyzed equals 76. This source inconsistency is already identified in the form and does not contradict its transcription of the reported analyzed counts.
Table 1 really prints 493 human-human teams and 976 human-human individuals; two people per team would instead imply 986. The form already flags this discrepancy; the PDF supplies no correction.

summary: The PDF confirms 2,234 analyzed people (1,258 human-AI; 976 human-human), including 2,034 in the diversity analysis, so criterion 2 holds. Source inconsistencies in attrition and team counts are already flagged in the form; I found no unsupported participant-count coding.
